Just finished v14.0, man that was a roller coaster of a ride.

  • Noriko is cute but crazy, years of searching for your sister's lost ex-boyfriend will do that I guess ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
  • Niki seems sorta clingy but moved on. Can't blame her though, dude just hopped out of her life.

  • Kirin, on the other hand, really cemented that FWB relationship. Wonder how that's gonna work in the future

  • Chika said something about the Nakayama's during the introduction of the new students, interesting.

I've been "pirating" this game long enough, time to be a big kid and pay for my toys.

posts.content_html_raw:
Darklord13 said:
But on the topic of public release, i wonder if it really is the best option for a developer to provide them, considering that the game in some cases will be leaked anyways.
Click to expand...
It's important to remember that the entire internet doesn't visit sites like this, so without a public release the average player would have no way to try a game in order to decide if it was worth their money. (Not like anyone makes demos anymore)
Yes, there would be some people who don't currently pay but would if they had to, but there would also be people who currently support the dev who wouldn't have spent money on a game sight-unseen and would have just moved on to something else. So if you're going purely for profit you could argue either way for which would get more paying players, but if you're going for more players in general, public releases are definitely the way to go.

Ok first of all.. this is the best way to get started. Ignore all girl events until you need them and how to determine that.

1. Start with Main Events Tracker Chapter 1
2. Check the further progress you are in on that Tracker
3. Click on the Guide/Wiki > go to https://lessonsinlove.wiki/wiki/Every_Day_I_Grow_Some_More
4. Go to the events and start at the 0.1.0 and go through them in order

Ok a good example let's say you have not done all the way to 0.3.0 events and you are now needing to do Girl Talk.
1. Click on Girl Talk
2. You will notice there is 2 requirements for this event to trigger: Seen: Carry Me Home ; Seen: Nothing Was Missing
3. Click on Carry Me Home and you will see that is a Sana Event requiring 15 affection and will trigger at the bar
4. Click on Nothing Was Missing, Except Me and you will see that is a Rin requiring affection 20 and requires the Missing Event

If you progress this way you will trigger what you need and will also see events that you need to trigger to get that event. So just follow the requirements in this method and ignore girl events you will get the girl events as you trigger what you require for the main story events. It took me a bit of a while to figure out this method as I was doing main girls than side girls and you will not get these main story events to properly trigger and you will remain stuck. I did not realize the guide and how it worked and I am on day 9xx something because of this.

So ive been to the Discord but was unable to find a dedicated channel for some theories (maybe i just didnt saw it). Only one general discussion thread and it was late so i didnt look through it.

So for now i might as well go into more detail about what i think here.

But for everyone who does not want to get maybe heavily spoilered should really omit the whole spoiler block.

If i remeber correctly thirst thing we see in the game is Sensei even good ol Sensei trying to be a bird (taking the easy exit).
So many options and all he could think of was to jump (end it all).
I guess this might even be before the first cycle even the reason we are now where we are.

Even before baby finches there are several clues about what might be happening.
One of the more unambiguously is the sound of a heart monitor in one of the happy events. While i dont think it should sound as it does. I guess normally it should be more regularly and not like a lung machine.
But this might just be connected to the iambic pentameter.

Further we have that "andwiresandwires" and "everything is connected" phrases.
For me its more like everyone is connected by wires.
But why?
I dont know at which time the real world is supposed to be, maybe sometime in the future i dont know.
This could all mean that good ol Sensei survived his attempted suicide and is now in some kind of rehabilitation center or hospital.
Even a technologically high advanced one.

Then theres baby finches. I dont know why i couldnt find any discussion about it here because wow, if i understood correctly it just tells us that old Sensei and Maya where in a relationship. And that before his attempted suicide.
This and that Maya had/has some kind of really dark personality and old Sensei was ok with it maybe even shared some of it.

So i try to put it all together.
Old Sensei tries to kill himself and survives. Teeth turning to crumbs and liquify(blood) -> his face meeting concrete?
He does because someone died (sister, niece(daughter?), girlfriend) and couldnt take it anymore.
He gets plugged into some kind of life support machine.
Damage done by jumping of a building hitting your head breaking your neck -> high probability of brain damage.
Life support machine cabable of restoring brain functions? -> High tech. Even able to connect other people to it for some kind of VR treatment ->terminals, ports, ip, users.
Maya as one of at least three connected people misses her boyfriend and tries resetting him until he becomes his former self.

I can see why Maya is holding a grudge against new Sensei. If he's her old boyfriend with new personality thats some new level of betraying with all the other girls.
The point where Sensei gives her the scarf with her nearly having a meltdown might be a sign for her that there is still some old Sensei left. And even a sign that he might never come back completely but stays how he is now.

In the end there is still much left i dont get if im not totally wrong to begin with.
Maya must be really good hiding her true personality and is lying almost all the time.
At least one connected person is trying to get control of some of the other users or entities within the simulation which i guess is Maya. When Yumi asks Sensei about lost memories the "event" gets skipped.
I wonder whats in those packages new Sensei is carrying for Maya before every world reset. A sacrifice? I hope its not some kinda 7 thing whats in the box stuff. Like the animals she so concurrently says shes killing in baby finches.

There is so much more in the back of my mind but i got to stop here for now because its already a big wall of text and surely has a lot of typos which i might edit out later.

Maybe ill add or remove some things later once my mind is a bit clearer.

Actually, I think you might be spot on with Ami. It fits very well. I think there is little discussion that there actually was a baby/kid involved that was Sensei's daughter and died but Amy does indeed fit better for a lot of reasons.

It would also explain why he does not actually remember her during the very beginning and the immediate resets. He can't remember her as she died when she was way younger, therefore he could have no subconscious idea who she is until told. Plus it would kinda explain wire-Ami.

Which means Ami is a projection of his fractured, subconscious mind in line with the post suicide recovery.
Which I also think can be taken mostly for a given. He is in recovery, not awake and via hightech Maya can actually link to his mind helping him recover/repair the damage/restore his mind.

But here is the thing that got me wondering. With all the above, and the knowledge that there are only 2 and a half actual people connected to his mind (one being Sensei, User2, one being Maya, User1, and the other half are floating memories of Old(sen)sei leading to events like baby finches or the HJ scene or the flashbacks, old memories and such.

And if there are only 2 real person's involved, and from the other characters Ami not actually existing even remotely as pictured in-game but a projection to his memory and guilt?.... Then this may even be true for other characters as well, probablymaybe all of them?

All of them, with their rich and very different personalities and problems could be merely be part of the full character Sensei has been before his suicide and also the very reasons that led to it.

Makotos longing to break out, Rins depression and boths feelings of emptiness, Yumis aggression as a result of her vulnerability and fear of being exploited, Sana being shut in and feeling like not needing anyone else, Chikas fear of losing a beloved one and hate me for pointing that out but as beautiful as Chinami is as a person, her story will not have a happy ending and I feel she tells part of true Amis story, Ayanes hatred/disappointment for her father (and her clingyness), Miku indicating a very actual childhood traumata (and maybe the discontent with a certain body part and it's short length^^) , Futabas discontent with her appearance ect ect.

His fractured, shattered mind tries to remember what he once was, all of it, all of what made him the person he was (and in a way all of what makes each single one of us the persons we are, with our myriad of different personality traits and issues). Yet it cannot do it directly, maybe as a form of self protection or simply because of the vast damage to his brain. It can only do it via a proxy, thus creating them as cute little girls like the true degenerate that Oldsei is to make it more bearable for himself ^^

As a sidenote it would also fit very very well with Makoto as a whole. She that wanted to be a perfect teacher, that wanted to truly help and teach but always felt so displaced, so forced into a situation and role that she found no other way to break out than to finally led go of everything, including her own very life. In a way, I am quite certain it was not Makoto that tried to fly in Bluejay, I had that feeling before already but now I am much more confident about that.

And in such a scenario, Maya truly would have a point reacting to Newsei the way she does, especially since this is not her first Rodeo with this situations, there were likely a whole lot of other iterations between current Newsei and actual Oldsei that all kinda failed to restore his mind.
And it would explain why she is so appaled to see Newsei fucking his own projections instead of actually trying to deal with the underlying issues that would finally heal him and bring him back to her. That would also truly underline why Newsei is indeed disgusting a man of culture. ^^
Would also explain why Maya was just one day there in the life of the other girls as Ami once said. Just in a really different way.

And it would fit with Selebus' plan for the story which he described as the current harem route first, then the sadness phase aka the projected memories and emotional scars forcefully break through and finally the purity routes (focusing on one "girl" after another) that would require Newsei to deal with the problems of his very own old self to finally find back and hopefully restore his mind.


Now I could be completely, utterly off with this assumption but I honestly would want to believe in that cause that would be truly a fucking beautiful story to be told. It already is but you know what I mean.

So in that regard, and I think I'll add a few more spoiler marks now just in case...

Praise be!

Actually, I think you might be spot on with Ami. It fits very well. I think there is little discussion that there actually was a baby/kid involved that was Sensei's daughter and died but Amy does indeed fit better for a lot of reasons.

It would also explain why he does not actually remember her during the very beginning and the immediate resets. He can't remember her as she died when she was way younger, therefore he could have no subconscious idea who she is until told. Plus it would kinda explain wire-Ami.

Which means Ami is a projection of his fractured, subconscious mind in line with the post suicide recovery.
Which I also think can be taken mostly for a given. He is in recovery, not awake and via hightech Maya can actually link to his mind helping him recover/repair the damage/restore his mind.

But here is the thing that got me wondering. With all the above, and the knowledge that there are only 2 and a half actual people connected to his mind (one being Sensei, User2, one being Maya, User1, and the other half are floating memories of Old(sen)sei leading to events like baby finches or the HJ scene or the flashbacks, old memories and such.

And if there are only 2 real person's involved, and from the other characters Ami not actually existing even remotely as pictured in-game but a projection to his memory and guilt?.... Then this may even be true for other characters as well, probablymaybe all of them?

All of them, with their rich and very different personalities and problems could be merely be part of the full character Sensei has been before his suicide and also the very reasons that led to it.

Makotos longing to break out, Rins depression and boths feelings of emptiness, Yumis aggression as a result of her vulnerability and fear of being exploited, Sana being shut in and feeling like not needing anyone else, Chikas fear of losing a beloved one and hate me for pointing that out but as beautiful as Chinami is as a person, her story will not have a happy ending and I feel she tells part of true Amis story, Ayanes hatred/disappointment for her father (and her clingyness), Miku indicating a very actual childhood traumata (and maybe the discontent with a certain body part and it's short length^^) , Futabas discontent with her appearance ect ect.

His fractured, shattered mind tries to remember what he once was, all of it, all of what made him the person he was (and in a way all of what makes each single one of us the persons we are, with our myriad of different personality traits and issues). Yet it cannot do it directly, maybe as a form of self protection or simply because of the vast damage to his brain. It can only do it via a proxy, thus creating them as cute little girls like the true degenerate that Oldsei is to make it more bearable for himself ^^

As a sidenote it would also fit very very well with Makoto as a whole. She that wanted to be a perfect teacher, that wanted to truly help and teach but always felt so displaced, so forced into a situation and role that she found no other way to break out than to finally led go of everything, including her own very life. In a way, I am quite certain it was not Makoto that tried to fly in Bluejay, I had that feeling before already but now I am much more confident about that.

And in such a scenario, Maya truly would have a point reacting to Newsei the way she does, especially since this is not her first Rodeo with this situations, there were likely a whole lot of other iterations between current Newsei and actual Oldsei that all kinda failed to restore his mind.
And it would explain why she is so appaled to see Newsei fucking his own projections instead of actually trying to deal with the underlying issues that would finally heal him and bring him back to her. That would also truly underline why Newsei is indeed disgusting a man of culture. ^^
Would also explain why Maya was just one day there in the life of the other girls as Ami once said. Just in a really different way.

And it would fit with Selebus' plan for the story which he described as the current harem route first, then the sadness phase aka the projected memories and emotional scars forcefully break through and finally the purity routes (focusing on one "girl" after another) that would require Newsei to deal with the problems of his very own old self to finally find back and hopefully restore his mind.


Now I could be completely, utterly off with this assumption but I honestly would want to believe in that cause that would be truly a fucking beautiful story to be told. It already is but you know what I mean.

So in that regard, and I think I'll add a few more spoiler marks now just in case...

Actually, I think you might be spot on with Ami. It fits very well. I think there is little discussion that there actually was a baby/kid involved that was Sensei's daughter and died but Amy does indeed fit better for a lot of reasons.

It would also explain why he does not actually remember her during the very beginning and the immediate resets. He can't remember her as she died when she was way younger, therefore he could have no subconscious idea who she is until told. Plus it would kinda explain wire-Ami.

Which means Ami is a projection of his fractured, subconscious mind in line with the post suicide recovery.
Which I also think can be taken mostly for a given. He is in recovery, not awake and via hightech Maya can actually link to his mind helping him recover/repair the damage/restore his mind.

But here is the thing that got me wondering. With all the above, and the knowledge that there are only 2 and a half actual people connected to his mind (one being Sensei, User2, one being Maya, User1, and the other half are floating memories of Old(sen)sei leading to events like baby finches or the HJ scene or the flashbacks, old memories and such.

And if there are only 2 real person's involved, and from the other characters Ami not actually existing even remotely as pictured in-game but a projection to his memory and guilt?.... Then this may even be true for other characters as well, probablymaybe all of them?

All of them, with their rich and very different personalities and problems could be merely be part of the full character Sensei has been before his suicide and also the very reasons that led to it.

Makotos longing to break out, Rins depression and boths feelings of emptiness, Yumis aggression as a result of her vulnerability and fear of being exploited, Sana being shut in and feeling like not needing anyone else, Chikas fear of losing a beloved one and hate me for pointing that out but as beautiful as Chinami is as a person, her story will not have a happy ending and I feel she tells part of true Amis story, Ayanes hatred/disappointment for her father (and her clingyness), Miku indicating a very actual childhood traumata (and maybe the discontent with a certain body part and it's short length^^) , Futabas discontent with her appearance ect ect.

His fractured, shattered mind tries to remember what he once was, all of it, all of what made him the person he was (and in a way all of what makes each single one of us the persons we are, with our myriad of different personality traits and issues). Yet it cannot do it directly, maybe as a form of self protection or simply because of the vast damage to his brain. It can only do it via a proxy, thus creating them as cute little girls like the true degenerate that Oldsei is to make it more bearable for himself ^^

As a sidenote it would also fit very very well with Makoto as a whole. She that wanted to be a perfect teacher, that wanted to truly help and teach but always felt so displaced, so forced into a situation and role that she found no other way to break out than to finally led go of everything, including her own very life. In a way, I am quite certain it was not Makoto that tried to fly in Bluejay, I had that feeling before already but now I am much more confident about that.

And in such a scenario, Maya truly would have a point reacting to Newsei the way she does, especially since this is not her first Rodeo with this situations, there were likely a whole lot of other iterations between current Newsei and actual Oldsei that all kinda failed to restore his mind.
And it would explain why she is so appaled to see Newsei fucking his own projections instead of actually trying to deal with the underlying issues that would finally heal him and bring him back to her. That would also truly underline why Newsei is indeed disgusting a man of culture. ^^
Would also explain why Maya was just one day there in the life of the other girls as Ami once said. Just in a really different way.

And it would fit with Selebus' plan for the story which he described as the current harem route first, then the sadness phase aka the projected memories and emotional scars forcefully break through and finally the purity routes (focusing on one "girl" after another) that would require Newsei to deal with the problems of his very own old self to finally find back and hopefully restore his mind.


Now I could be completely, utterly off with this assumption but I honestly would want to believe in that cause that would be truly a fucking beautiful story to be told. It already is but you know what I mean.

So in that regard, and I think I'll add a few more spoiler marks now just in case...

Praise be!

Miku

Futaba

Maya
So, a certain someone mentioned this somewhere.
Good old Einstein about what insanity is:
"Insanity is doing the same thing over and over and expecting different results."

Maya tossing that coin over and over for a specific outcome while everthing she might have to do is waiting for the coin to land on its edge.

Curious to see what you and maybe others think.

So i see we're on the same page again.
I also thought about that the majority of the girls could be fractures of old Senseis mind disassembled by Hope/The Overseer/ Master ai. So he can confront his own mental ailments in a nice way.
It also gives the term mindfuckery a funnier meaning .
But given how much girls we already have that be a lot of problems to fit into one single human being.

There are still a lot of things left.
One thing i might have overseen is which user was trying to take control over user3. I think its right at the start of the christmas event chain when yumi tries to ask Sensei about lost memories. I think i never saw a user1 mentioned why i thought it maybe Hope. But maybe it was just before i started to pay more attention.

Makoto
The moment Sensei was thinking that he might have planted a dark seed into her and i guess it was how it would become a sick rose.
The moment she wanted to go to the rooftop i knew she was trying to pull the birdie stunt.

Miku
I think i have a theory about her fear of loud noises. While i can see it being implemented differently storywise i guess going back to our fractured mind thing its related to the trauma and noise of a certain car crash.

Futaba
Mental ailments aside i guess shes old and even new Senseis interest in literature. Both know about the iambic pentameter. I wonder with how often puns are used "i am a big pent up meter" just to good.
And yeah i see the 4th wall crumble alot in the game. I can imagine why and see a big scheme behind it but i leave it at that because of a certain someone.

Kaori
So we have all those spider shadows in baby finches (noodles?) and a big spider tattoo on kaori as well. Before someone mentioned a possible relation to the ongoing space war i thought of her as some kind of sub ai metacrawler search engine. She even mentions that she uses a search engine for whatever it was. I really think the whole space war thing is just a make up so people dont try to cross the city borders.
But i guess we have to see where the story takes her. Just.. how do the chickens fit in? Especially that large spicemen of hers.

The 3 personed god (Father, son, holy ghost)
Im not very fond of religions. So i know not much about them. I stumbled across the term while i searched for what iambic pentameter is.
I get that the story and therefore Selebus has a different take on what the 3 personed god is. One of them being that fleshlight fucking ball of light (callous one?) and the second one being some kind of machine god (Hope, a nicer one).
So my guess is that if there are only 3 users connected that could make each one of them a representation of one of the 3 personed god. But that would mean hope is one of them. Because i think that he is that mentioned machine god (American gods relation?). Id rather say Hope is not a user but some kind of Master ai. Its all too ambiguous for me.

/e about 9pm cest. Got to get some structure into it.
Maya
So, a certain someone mentioned this somewhere.
Good old Einstein about what insanity is:
"Insanity is doing the same thing over and over and expecting different results."
I think of this being more of a kind of pov (point of view).
I just really wanted to get that Kain phrase into it because its feels so appropriate.
Maya tossing that coin over and over for a specific outcome while everthing she might have to do is waiting for the coin to land on its edge.

So, i guess i forgot something again. But its already a wall of text again too.
Curious to see what you and maybe others think.

Don't feel bad, I had to shell out almost six figures for a CS degree to learn it. There are much better ways to

For future reference, "vbox" means vertical box (vertical referring to the arrangement of the "text" objects) and are used as the columns of the table here. There was one big one originally, I just split it up into four.

"xpos" and "ypos" refer to the x (horizontal) and y (vertical) axis positions of the upper left corner of the vbox. We're using relative positioning here which goes from 0.0 to 1.0 to represent a position as a fraction of the total screen height or width. You can also think of it as 0% to 100% - so "xpos .25" means 25% across the screen from the left (all the way left is 0.0, all the way right is 1.0), and "ypos .15" means 15% of the way below the top (0.0 is the very top, 1.0 is the very bottom. Don't blame math for this being backwards, or even Renpy really, this is an old school computer graphics processing standard).

So to make room for more names at the bottom - I think a scrollbar will automatically show up if it overflows, but that sucks - all you would need to do is change the "ypos" values for each "vbox" to .10 or less. That will move the top of the columns higher.

And WTF is that "I'm sure" doing there? Are you actively trying to be offensive or something? It's condescending as hell.
Click to expand...
No, no I am not. If I was actively trying, it would be blatantly obvious. I can neither confirm nor deny that it was helpful because I did not use it, but I am sure that it was. I was being genuine in that remark, but the best I can say without having used it is what I said.
I actively avoid using any and all resources that could spoil things before I see them, so no guide and no wiki while I play. Everything is left to chance that the way I would decide each choice in the real world and the correct choice to maintain a perfect game are the same.
Inaccurate resources should be removed, period, it doesn't matter what it is or who made it. However, the wiki is directly linked in the game itself, giving it priority treatment as the go to source for information. Therefore, as the priority resource, it should be updated to reflect any changes that rendered current information inaccurate as soon as possible. This is also a case of inability to confirm or deny usefulness as I have only ever used the wiki to look up triggers of past events to assist here when other players have tried everything else and cannot proceed.
Korbinus said:
Dude, chill, you're way too mad. They didn't said guide should be removed "as quickly as possible", it's just that wiki is more official source, so the guide is becoming unnecessary, especially since the wiki is updated constatly and regularly. You said it yourself that updating the guide is not worth your time. Why are you so angry then?
Also, I don't see why are you so angry for the "I'm sure" bit. You're overinterpreting it, he just said that it was a great help to people, how is it condescending? It's just that the guide is getting more and more irrevelant
Click to expand...
That is not what I said, what I said was indeed that the, now inaccurate, guide should be removed. However, at the same time, nowhere did I say it should not return in an accurate form. Inaccurate help resources can lead players into dead end situations just as easily as a player not having the right girl at the right affection or lust for each event.
IF cckerberos says at any time it is not worth it to update the guide, it should indeed be permanently removed. It must be updated to remain or it poses the threat of steering players off course. You are correct that it was taken way too harshly as it was meant as a statement of fact, resources need to be removed when no longer accurate and should be updated if someone is willing or left off the thread if not.
The 'I'm sure' bit was misinterpreted, also correct. It was interpreted as if I meant something against the resource, but what I actually meant was I was sure that it helped many, but that I could not confirm that because I have never used it. If I had used it, I would not have made that part of the statement as I would be fully aware of the fact of whether it was or wasn't for myself instead of simply having faith that it was.
cckerberos said:
They literally said that it "should be removed as soon as possible."
And I absolutely did not say that updating the guide is not worth my time. I've already uploaded a corrected version with the new Bluejay triggers and have a 0.15.0 version ready for when that's made public. Click to expand...

The part about not checking event triggers every update is only true when there aren't changes to said triggers, which can only be known one of two ways. Either Selebus tells us or someone checks them. During the development of the game, which is going to last several years, these triggers can change at any point in time, rendering both the current guide and wiki at the time immediately inaccurate the second the version with the new triggers is released. This could lead to players getting stuck because they are following the old information related to the triggers that are no longer in effect.
Development at this stage, literally 15 versions in, is far too chaotic, literally anything under the hood could change out of necessity at any time. I highly doubt it will happen, there's MAYBE a 0.0000001% chance, but Selebus could attempt to do something in the code that would require all triggers to be rewritten. Not exactly common practice or a common occurrence when not necessarily done intentionally, but it can and does happen within the realm of game development.
Korbinus said:
I might be blind, but I can't see the "as soon as possible" part.

alex2011 said:
No, no I am not. If I was actively trying, it would be blatantly obvious. I can neither confirm nor deny that it was helpful because I did not use it, but I am sure that it was. I was being genuine in that remark, but the best I can say without having used it is what I said.

I actively avoid using any and all resources that could spoil things before I see them, so no guide and no wiki while I play. Everything is left to chance that the way I would decide each choice in the real world and the correct choice to maintain a perfect game are the same.

Inaccurate resources should be removed, period, it doesn't matter what it is or who made it. However, the wiki is directly linked in the game itself, giving it priority treatment as the go to source for information. Therefore, as the priority resource, it should be updated to reflect any changes that rendered current information inaccurate as soon as possible. This is also a case of inability to confirm or deny usefulness as I have only ever used the wiki to look up triggers of past events to assist here when other players have tried everything else and cannot proceed.


That is not what I said, what I said was indeed that the, now inaccurate, guide should be removed. However, at the same time, nowhere did I say it should not return in an accurate form. Inaccurate help resources can lead players into dead end situations just as easily as a player not having the right girl at the right affection or lust for each event.


IF cckerberos says at any time it is not worth it to update the guide, it should indeed be permanently removed. It must be updated to remain or it poses the threat of steering players off course. You are correct that it was taken way too harshly as it was meant as a statement of fact, resources need to be removed when no longer accurate and should be updated if someone is willing or left off the thread if not.

The 'I'm sure' bit was misinterpreted, also correct. It was interpreted as if I meant something against the resource, but what I actually meant was I was sure that it helped many, but that I could not confirm that because I have never used it. If I had used it, I would not have made that part of the statement as I would be fully aware of the fact of whether it was or wasn't for myself instead of simply having faith that it was.


I did, it needed to be removed and the new version uploaded, which you did do. The part about not checking event triggers every update is only true when there aren't changes to said triggers, which can only be known one of two ways. Either Selebus tells us or someone checks them. During the development of the game, which is going to last several years, these triggers can change at any point in time, rendering both the current guide and wiki at the time immediately inaccurate the second the version with the new triggers is released. This could lead to players getting stuck because they are following the old information related to the triggers that are no longer in effect.

Development at this stage, literally 15 versions in, is far too chaotic, literally anything under the hood could change out of necessity at any time. I highly doubt it will happen, there's MAYBE a 0.0000001% chance, but Selebus could attempt to do something in the code that would require all triggers to be rewritten. Not exactly common practice or a common occurrence when not necessarily done intentionally, but it can and does happen within the realm of game development.


I did say it and as soon as possible was meant to avoid as many players getting stuck as possible, which was only avoidable in connectiion with the guide and wiki by removing and/or fixing them as soon as possible. As far as making the wiki more accessible, I'm not sure any more can be done. It is linked in game, it is linked in the thread, it constantly gets referenced by players trying to assist other players, there's just not much more that can be done. I could think of ways to make the wiki itself easier to navigate, but accessing it is about as easy as it can get.

Example, I've noticed some pages don't link very well to others like trying to get to another page from the front page of the wiki. Normally, a wiki will have links to several useful pages like a main page for characters or events that would then have links to the individual pages for the same. However, from the front page the last time I was on, I could only get anywhere by using the search bar.


No, I could see a use for having both. The wiki is the source the game uses, but it may or may not be as easily understood. I've seen multiple cases outside of LiL on this site where there was both a wiki and a guide and one was more easy to understand, was laid out more clearly, or some other advantage over the other, usually the guide being the one with the advantage.



As do I, more resources to help is a good thing as long as they are kept up to date.




Technically you could change whatever variable controls the event's status using the console, but this does run a pretty good risk to your save. There really isn't a way without fucking up the save once it has an event listed as a certain status. At that point, you run the risk of fucking it up if you attempt to make any change that sets that status to a different one. There is only one surefire way to not fuck up the save and unlock everything and that is to get everything right from the start, which is the nightmare Selebus is referring to, I'm pretty sure. Not an easy task by any means, but the best way to do what you want without the risk.

You shouldn't need to run the whole 30 hours even if you were to take the hit and play through the missed events again. There should be a save somewhere that occurred closer to your current point without the missed events. Try the auto save section of the load screen, should be the A category to the left of the page numbers on the load screen.


Absolutely not, it is my mission to make this happen at all costs, even if I must bear the pain of lying to one or more of the girls.


Truly the most evil of methods, letting our own acts eat away at us until the very moment when karma comes calling.


That is no easy task, nice work. This game goes out of its way to make you fail at every turn, the most common strategy in my case being the correct choice being the one I myself would never choose, Karin is a prime example of this. You'll know when you see the event I'm referring to, no spoilers here.

If Selebus had merch, I would be out of money and would have to cancel my subscription for a short while to recover. I am not joking when I say I would have my walls covered in said merch as soon as I could get my hands on it, or an equivalent for electronic merch. I would literally buy everything, every single item on sale.


That's actually pretty impressive, just a few more days and we'll see if that comes to pass. It's like people are gaining such a respect for the game as to not share patron only builds nearly as much as other games get hit with it. I do hope that it does and that instead comes an equivalent influx of patrons.


Yes please


Exactly, there are some developers so bad, some even resulting from an intentional act, that pirating is the only real option. Selebus makes it very much the opposite. It is so well taken care of that we instead feel that it isn't necessarily worth pirating, which is not to say that it is too bad to pirate, it's quite the opposite. On a pirating forum like this, that is no simple task and not that many games get treated like this. It is absolutely worth being a patron, I do not regret and cannot foresee ever regretting becoming one.


Indeed, at this quality, you could give us half an hour and it would be worth $10. There is very little that could detract enough value to make the game no longer worth the cost and I cannot foresee what little could cause that happening in your hands.


That last one is what I do, rolling back and forth to read it word by word, those messages are quick.


While it is part of the map by default, it does fit quite nicely and does sort of clue us in on some potential plot points.


Good idea on the sticky note, you never know when something seemingly harmless is actually an important detail.


I just keep it as a separate account and only ever use Discord for degenerate stuff anyway. I've been over to the Discord a couple times, though usually only when I need to get to Selebus about something to do with subscription benefits. I think the last time I was there was when I first signed up. I just keep this and the SubscribeStar open at all times to get any information.

Oh my sweet summer child, this is 100% a pirate site. It just so happens that some developers realize that all publicity is good publicity, so it's better to cooperate (and thus retain some influence and control) than to fight it and accomplish nothing.

If Selebus did not post here this thread would continue to exist, and the main difference would be that the "patrons only" build would likely get posted a day or so after the release instead of waiting for the public release. But, since Selebus is involved in F95, he owns the thread and thus can protect the exclusivity he promised his paying patrons. This is acceptable to the (largely piratical) community, because having him here offers other value-- we know he reads our feedback, he answers questions, etc.

In addition to some modest level of control, the developer also benefits because (a) the feedback here is a bit more broad-based than he will get on Discord or Patreon, where nearly 100% of the feedback is written by serious fans who will only have nice things to say (otherwise they wouldn't be there), and (b) it gets more eyeballs onto the game. (I follow many games on SS and Patreon, and in most of the cases I found them here first, played the pirated version, and decided I liked it enough to support the creator. I'm sure others do this as well.)

Edit: Selebus clarified that while the thread's OP is in his name, he does not actually control/update the download links. Interesting!

Just to give some perspective-- the actual harm being done consists of the intersection of "people who are 100% willing to pay for the early release" and "people who don't because piracy is an option". I suspect that this is a handful of people at most. The law is on his side of course-- it's his IP-- but if (somehow, magically) the user data could be analyzed and it would probably show that all the people who can-and-would-but-don't-have-to-so-don't can be counted on very few fingers. Someone who does not want to support the game won't, and those who wish to, do. If F95 was advertised on Selebus's Patreon page (or in-game like Light of My Life) that might be another matter.

Selebus is smart enough to give the game away after a short pause; it's very high quality, so casual fans probably turn into supporters at a pretty good clip. (The developers who really benefit from piracy are the idiots who release a crippled [or extremely old] version of their game that nobody in their right mind would pay for, but get fans anyway because it is trivial to find a copy that actually represents the game they'd be supporting.)

TL,DR: The tiered reward system + staggered releases is great for influencing the Patreon person clicking "Support" and trying to decide on a tier, but I don't think those people are negatively swayed by the existence of pirate sites. I certainly never have been-- I take it for granted that *any* game is easily obtained illegally.

They do have to be careful depending on their country, though. While producing adult games isn't illegal in most, some countries still view it as something that should not be done or at least should not be talked about. This is why the Japanese market rarely makes significant strides and the developers in that market that do are working solo and have no intention of going anywhere else with those skills. Unfortunately, and this applies to the Japanese in particular, some view the origin of the skill as more important than having the skill itself or it at least appears that way. Even if a Japanese developer gains programming skills, if they gained said skills through adult games and are in the market for a big company like Nintendo, they are likely to be passed over by Nintendo for the fact that their skill originated on the adult side of the industry.

A prime example of this is Illusion, the company that made the game this game uses the art style from. Illusion very rarely makes any significant improvements and there are two reasons for this. The first is their customer base, which seems to prioritize customization, so the rest of the game suffers a drop in quality because Illusion then focuses on customization. The second is a stigma especially prevalent in Japan around anything porn. In Japan and other countries with this idiotic stigma, you often see developers keep their employment and companies like Illusion secret from even their families and they will leave the company as soon as they are able, which is usually at the end of their first and only project. Very rarely does even one employee at a company like Illusion get to work on more than a single project at a single company. They instead use it as practice and a stepping stone to the big boys like Nintendo. Couple that with Illusion's switch to Unity from their own engine that kept getting increasingly incompatible with newer changes to Windows and they had an issue, an abundance of newbie developers with little to no skill in Unity specifically and no veterans with enough skill in Unity to teach the newbies properly.

Selebus does not have to worry about this because the US does not bear this stigma despite the overly zealous religious leaders and followers not wanting porn to be a thing that exists.

I'm just saying, whether it is a good kickstarter or not is entirely dependent on the culture of the country you are in.

Awkwardly serious reply incoming (might be sick).

The reason is that in RL people usually have very close ties to the people around them and there actions and behavior has a ton of implication and consequences. We have to behave following social norms as every deviation from those norms would potentially have very direct results for our relationships, private, professional or otherwise.

People talk and think about others around them a lot and also talk about those people, and therefore behavior that's not normatively approved can result in a lot of other people becoming aware of that, even if the person talking about those did not do it with ill thoughts or intend.
Therefore, knowing that, we usually pay a lot more attention how we behave and adapt it to whom we hang out with.


On the internet, the huge avantage is anonymity. You don't have to pay too much attention to society norms because it won't likely affect your personal life even if it backfires. People also usually do not care too much or think about you on the internet, which means it's less likely they will actually talk about you with others. This knowledge is the main reason people will not try to act too adult on the internet (except to win a discussion or lecture others, people love that).

Cause frankly, most of the seriousness comes from the fear of being called out for inappropriate behavior which does mean we have to act serious to prevent that. If you are close to a lot of people in the 30s or 40s you realize they are not as serious or adult as they appear to be in a professional or public area. It's a necessary facade.

I'm not saying we can't be serious or adult, I'm very obviously implying that we can and do that. But we also still can follow our inner childs, if we are in a context where we don't think we will be called out for it. The anonymity of the internet usually fulfills this criteria.

The impact of that one dorm event for Maya, I'm actually scared for her sake now and the wallpapers shared earlier bring flashbacks of her face as she tries to smile for our sake. If I must hurt her in the short term to gain her trust in the long term when she finally realizes that what I did was right, so be it, I will take that bullet willingly just so I can see her finally drop the attitude and be thankful someone else was finally there for her when she needed it most. I know she has Chika, but she doesn't seem to let Chika help her either, so help must be forced on her.

posts.content_html_raw:
Well, I just choked on my own spit from laughter after "Uptown Girl". Sensei just calling Niki like that almost literally killed me. I can't wait until the next Niki event to see her reaction firsthand.

The rest of the update was quite a mix between heartwarming and foreboding, though. You can definitely see the signs of this whole "route" crashing in tears, but with it picking up speed as it does now, it's at least going to be spectacular. Nice to see Sensei getting closer to problems and mysteries of the world in general and Maya in particular, too, even if he is rapidly losing control over himself.

The plot between Noriko and Maya thickens, and I get the feeling the latter was really hurt by it. I wonder if Niki couldn't be a more neutral source of information about the past, though. Maya doesn't seem to have so adverse a reaction to her, and you would think that supposedly girlfriend would know more about whaterver happened.

The code and assets for this game are uncompressed/obfuscated, so you could just go into the game's files and look for the images in question's names then find them in the images folder. This is a little harder if you don't know how the game handles its code or if you can't read ren'py code in the first place.

A good suggestion is to check the "Xevents.rpy" (where X is the character in question's name) file or the "dormX.rpy" file where X is 1 (iirc, either that or nothing) for first floor dorms and 2 for second floor dorms. Open the file in question with notepad and search for the last line displayed (or a substring of it) and then use that to find the image names.

Ahh, no, it's become like every other harem game! (Yes I know it was a joke and I too am joking, but that really is what 90% of the harem games are like, and the few that aren't are a breath of fresh air.)
Click to expand...
That and a lot of them move too quickly into sex, which limits the time in which the character can be built upon. Sure, they could build up the character after the fact, but these games often don't last long enough after the fact to build the character and that's assuming the game lasts through its entire development cycle. Character development tends to be a lot more effective when done over a long period of time and before anything significant happens. If the character is pushed into sex by the developer too early, it just makes them seem like a total slut even if they are supposed to be completely pure no matter what their development is like after. The player will remember that that character started a physical relationship not long after the initial relationship began. That works when the character is supposed to be a total slut in the first place, or at least a girl with an overactive libido like Kirin, but not for a good 99.9% of character types. As an opposite example, it would not work with Karin.

There's also the issue where the girls automatically fall for the MC in those games, that isn't the case here. We have girls in this game he's been pursuing since day one that are still not into him or that are more into someone else than him even if there is something there in his favor. The relationships in this game are much more natural. Sure, there's Ayane, but that's Ayane just being Ayane. It's just the way she is, totally devoted to the MC. Try putting Yumi in that situation and it would just feel forced.

spoilers.title: Noriko, Maya, Sensei, Niki
spoilers.html:
Sensei had a relationship with Niki and always was a kind of isolated person.
He tutored Noriko and Maya while having a relationship with Niki.
Noriko fell for Sensei during that time. Childhood love, love interest what ever, onesided.
Then i guess it was around when Senseis sister died when he left Niki and lived even more isolated.
Some time after that Maya and Sensei start a relationship. Why? Im pretty sure its because they shared some kind of horrible personal experience and or mental ailments.
Noriko mentions something in .14 that sounds like she knows that Sensei and Maya were a couple. Something like "Shes trying (will try) to get you back".

I have my own theory about Mayas agenda. So, Spoiler Warning
If im correct that Maya wants her old mentaly ill Sensei back because they were like soulmates its difficult to understand why she tries to prevent Sensei from knowing too much (the past).
She insinuates that new Sensei might in fact be old Sensei (with missing or messed up memories).
And if he finds out about himself the world would end or at least Sensei gets erased out of that world or becomes a mental neutrum.
Maybe he will just leave the "world" while she will still be stuck there.
There might even be a hint to that. In .15p1 when Sensei uses his "Scan ability" which categorizes her as "Broken beyond repair".

"This town has two halves". A brain has two halves. Maybe one half of Senseis brain is damaged. Would explain why being in the more unknown half of the city makes him go on autopilot.

Alright so some of the the stuff in these new updates has got me thinking and I've come up with a few thoughts about what's going on...

- We have learned next to nothing about Ami parents, and that feels kinda suspicious...I kinda doubt their role in the story is just to be Ami's parents and then traumatize Ami and Sensei with their death. I can't help feeling they have some greater role in the wider story.

- The new Maya scenes have shown that at least one of the causes of Sensei's glitchy freak-outs is him learning about his past, so let's take a moment to list the characters who Sensei had major freak-outs around:
Maya
Yumi
Ami
Kaori
There's been others but unless I'm forgetting one those were all really minor, like little cuts/blips compared to the ones around these characters.
But doesn't this seem strange? Where's Noriko and Niki? Maybe it's just early in their events and it'll happen later but besides one really minor blip he hasn't really freaked out around them as much as you would think. Also Yumi in particular causes a lot of freak-outs but Maya never really warned Sensei not to interact with her... This makes me like 70% certain that whoever is in Sensei's body isn't, like a later version of the same person or anything but another person entirely.

- I'm thinking about that nice/helpful system voice that showed up during Yumi new events (they showed up earlier but I forget which event, I believe they were called USER3?). I doubt they are a wholly unfamiliar entity but I don't have really good guess as to who...Maybe Ami's mother? If that wild guess is right it could suggest we are actually Ami's father/Sensei's brother, which would track my other two points. But's that's really just a guess I don't really have any evidence.

1. A walkthrough for the game doesn't really exist. Both the wiki linked to from the game's main menu and the guide linked to in the OP are primarily lists of the various events with their triggers. They're intended to help people who are stuck rather than to tell someone to do A, then B, etc. The guide is probably more useful for quickly finding missable events as they're crossed out in red (I don't think the wiki has a list, but I could be wrong).
2. There are a few missable events in the game, but most of these are pretty obvious. One is really only obvious in hindsight and there are probably three places in the game where a player might find themselves stuck (they only have one solution, though, so you don't need to be worried about doing them "wrong"). I personally wouldn't let these deter you from playing. It's also worth remembering that the game is still pretty early on in its story and we really don't know what the consequences of things are yet.

But two points still.

First, they are not the "same" characters. People in RL share a ton of character traits yet still are totally different personalities and characters and that is here in this game very sure for the 3 you and Alex argued about. Ami, Ayane and Noriko are extremely different personalities that do have their own subset of characteristics, one of which is their obsession with Sensei but for completely different reasons (though Ami and Ayane share a bit background there. Still, the reasons are different). That does make them very much not the same in my book. Implying they are basically the same is honestly an oversimplification that stems from the sole belief that this has to be the case, not actually paying attention to their dialogues, sorry for my bluntness there.

Second, denpa or not, it doesn't mean there cannot be a somewhat good ending. I am very certain that there will be at least some form of redemption and "happy end" for Maya, but not in a way that is without constraints. That also wouldn't fit the entire concept or story seen so far so there's that. What we know from what Sel has planned is that after the harem and the sad part, there will be purity routes (focusing on single characters mainly) that lead to the actual ending, eventually.
This alone does imply it will not end as your usual denpa either.
Again, I am certain it will not be an "all is good and gravy" ending because it doesn't fit with the entire depth of the story, but it will be a good ending for such a deep and thoughtful story that the game tries to tell.

If that is not enough for you then this is tots fine. But your message kinda gave me the impression that you assume the game will end in tragedy and despair only, and even without knowing any of Sels actual plans, I am certain that won't be the case.

Click to expand...
Each character is assigned a specific location in each time slot and only one is in each location per time slot, it is fairly obvious once you've gone a few days and have been able to see every location available in all time slots available. Therefore, there is no need for such an indicator. If they could switch locations based on weekday, I could see a use for an indicator like that, but it's not like Chika can be at the mall in the afternoon on Saturday and Yumi can be at the mall in the afternoon on Sunday, they are always in the same location at the same time slot every day. No, guest appearances of other characters in the event of the character that is supposed to be there don't count since only the character who is supposed to be there gets incremented. For example, if Yumi appears at the mall, it is only during a mall event and she will not be given more lust or affection by appearing in that event because it was specifically a Chika event. In this example, Chika is the character that is supposed to be there and Yumi is making a guest appearance in a Chika event, therefore only Chika gets lust or affection.

EDIT: Made my last comment more accurate to avoid confusion, nobody is going to be at the mall on Monday or Tuesday, those are weekdays and they only have one time slot.
